name: ws-s3-eth-8di-8ro
title: Waveshare ESP32-S3-ETH-8DI-8RO
notes: ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U N16R8 (16 MB flash, 8 MB octal PSRAM, SMA antenna). Soldered W5500 on SPI2: CS 16, INT 12, RST 39. Pins: Waveshare wiki, Waveshare Arduino demo (WS_ETH.h), ESPHome devices page; the wiki omits RST, the demo and the 8DI-8DO wiki give GPIO39. Also covers the PoE (ESP32-S3-POE-ETH-8DI-8RO) and CAN (-C) versions. The TF slot is wired for SDMMC 1-bit only (CLK 48, CMD 47, D0 45, no CS), which the S3 image can't use: zones and blocking live in RAM only. Relays behind a TCA9554 on I2C; DI on GPIO4-11.
